author: KiraTV
description:
What happens when two people meet online in a video game, and they share a passion for making money? What about when they have access to the dark web, and illegal narcotics? That's how NeverpressedRX was created. But how it ended, was in flames. Almost literally. Their true plan "operation firewood" was in the works, and the only thing that stopped them, was the FBI.
